FieldsOfFire.description: Friendly units with the <style="Emplacement">Emplacement</style> trait deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> against units that are {[range]} or more hexes away from their own hex. Each time <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Thaddeus Noble</style> is attacked in <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style> or would get <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style>, he loses <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> in addition to the damage done. The first time each round he loses <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> this way, all friendly <style="Emplacement">Emplacement</style> units get <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> for 1 round.
